meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 在搜 X/Twitter 时会先确认 xAI 是否已连接，然后把查询按日期限定、限定可信账号、拆成 2~3 次搜索，并用 web_search 交叉核对，每条结论都附 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你提到“X search”“tweets”等关键词，或要求查 X 上的讨论时触发。需要已连接 xAI 账号，否则会说明不可用并退回 web_search。

say.text: 搜一下 X 上最近关于英伟达的讨论，只看我信任的那几个账号
say.note: 会按日期限定，并只搜你指定的账号

say.text: X 上有人说这家公司财报超预期吗？和网页新闻对一下
say.note: 会同时跑 web_search 并说明两者是否一致

say.text: 把这个推文链接的回复和引用都找出来
say.note: 会单独发一次 thread fetch 查询

howto.what_en: With xAI connected, Claude date-bounds X searches (from_date from yesterday, widened to 7 days), scopes trusted accounts via allowed_x_handles, splits into 2-3 queries, cross-checks web_search, and cites an x.com URL for every claim.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “X search”, “tweets” or similar, or ask what people say on X. Needs a connected xAI account; otherwise it reports x_search unavailable and falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for recent talk about Nvidia, only from the accounts I trust
say_en.note: Date-bounds the query and limits it to your handles

say_en.text: Is anyone on X saying this company beat earnings? Check the news too
say_en.note: Runs web_search in the same turn and notes agreement

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for this tweet link
